geology_notes: Black Raven Gold-Silver-Antimony Project in central Newfoundland is the core asset. The spring 2026 two-rig, 23-hole, 4,267-metre campaign confirmed world-class antimony grades: headline result 19.23% Sb and 0.73 g/t Au across 1.4m at Frost Cove North (final assays released August 28, 2026). Prior 2025 holes returned 7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m. A June 2026 prospecting program returned grab samples of 9.46% Sb, 35.5 g/t Au, and 1,118 g/t Ag from quartz veins at a historic mine site, with two separate samples exceeding 10% Sb. Pomley Cove Pond intersected 20 gold-silver-molybdenum-lead-zinc veins within a 150m-wide structural swarm. Golden Baie (acquired March 2026; 1,597 claims over 399 km²) adds a second antimony-gold corridor, both within 100km of Beaver Brook Antimony Mine. No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists; the base technical report dates to August 2023 and predates the consolidated 2025–2026 drilling database. Project remains discovery-stage despite exceptional high-grade intercepts.

The spring 2026 two-rig Black Raven campaign (4,267m, 23 holes) delivered world-class grades including 19.23% Sb at Frost Cove North (final assays released August 28, 2026), and a June 2026 prospecting program added grab samples up to 35.5 g/t Au and 1,118 g/t Ag alongside greater-than-10% Sb hits. The Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026; 399 km²) consolidates a second antimony-gold corridor. CEO Tasheel Jeerh (appointed May 2026) signals strategic ambition; a $2M private placement reported complete post-May 2026 provides additional exploration runway. No new material news identified as of October 30, 2026.
